resources.string: View public LuckPool data for a VRSC address. This is a read-only monitor for external miners. It does not start mining on this phone.
VRSC mainnet R-address · never a seed or private key
Send this public address to LuckPool when I refresh. LuckPool also receives my network IP. The address is saved only on this device until I delete it.
Stopped. No automatic refresh or mining.

Amounts belong to the queried public address, not a verified MARS-X account. These are pool-reported values, not an app balance. Payment TXIDs are pool reports; blockchain confirmations have not been checked. No credit, exchange, withdrawal or MARS-X fee is created here.
Invalid VRSC R-address checksum. Check the full address.
Pool data is over 5 minutes old. Refresh to check again.
LuckPool has no miner record for this address. Mining has not been confirmed.
Pool data could not be validated. No balance has been credited.
Pool connection failed. Check your network and try again.
Pool “shares” value: %1$s (not a verified accepted-share count)
Pool balance: %1$s VRSC\nImmature rewards: %2$s VRSC\nTotal paid by pool: %3$s VRSC
No payments reported by this endpoint.
